verdict.rationale: Statsig documents Dynamic Configs as a first-class entity alongside Feature Gates, with values retrievable through the HTTP API and scoped per target app. Experiments also serve different variants to test groups, so non-boolean configuration is clearly a product capability. However, no evidence describes the value types (strings, numbers, JSON) or how multivariate flag values are defined, and Feature Gates themselves return only pass/fail. Missing for 10: documentation of supported value types (string/number/JSON), explicit multivariate flag definitions, SDK getter examples for typed config values, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve multivariate flags and dynamic configuration values (strings, numbers, JSON), not just booleans
